trace.reasoning: The MRI and CT images show a large pericardial effusion with significant right atrial and ventricular compression, consistent with cardiac tamponade physiology. This finding supports constrictive pericarditis (Option C) as the underlying etiology, where chronic inflammation leads to fibrosis and constriction. While restrictive cardiomyopathy (Option D) also presents with diastolic dysfunction, the imaging here specifically demonstrates pericardial pathology rather than intrinsic myocardial disease, making C the more precise diagnosis.
